name: KC Wine Co Mahjong 101
description: Winery in Olathe that hosts occasional beginner mahjong lessons. Its event page says: "The fee covers your two-hour instruction, an NMJL official card, and a beverage of your choice."
schedule: Occasional lessons; next: Sun Dec 6 2026 12:00-2:00 PM

name: The Bam Bam Room KC
description: Dedicated mahjong parlor in Leawood (opened Sept 2025). Martin City Telegraph describes it as featuring the Americanized version of mahjong; its own site does not mention American/NMJL, so rule set unconfirmed. Site lists Open Play, Mahjong 101 + 102 beginner lessons, and day/night league play.
schedule: Wed-Sat 10 AM-5 PM (some events until 8-9 PM); open play listed at $8; lessons $100 for two 2-hour sessions per Martin City Telegraph (site shows $120)

name: Johnson County Parks & Recreation 50 Plus Mah Jongg
description: JCPRD 50 Plus weekly Mah Jongg drop-in at five community centers (Tomahawk Ridge in Overland Park; Meadowbrook Park Clubhouse in Prairie Village; New Century Fieldhouse; Roeland Park Community Center; Mill Creek Activity Center in Shawnee) plus Intro to Mah Jongg classes. The pages do not say American/NMJL explicitly (the intro class gives each player a current Mah Jongg card).
schedule: Tue 1-4 PM (Mill Creek also 5:15-7:15 PM; New Century Fieldhouse); Wed 1-4 PM (Meadowbrook); Thu 1-4 PM (Tomahawk Ridge; Roeland Park). Suggested $1 per person drop-in
